# 1956 – A Szabadság Népe | 70. évforduló

Canonical site: https://1956.vipach.at/

This public site presents a historical 1956 anniversary project. Historical events described on the site are editorial/historical subject matter and should not be interpreted as current Event rich-result objects unless a page explicitly represents a real current event.

Primary pages:
- https://1956.vipach.at/
- https://1956.vipach.at/projekt.html
- https://1956.vipach.at/diaspora.html — Magyar identitás a diaszpórában, családi emlékezet és 1956 (HU)
- https://1956.vipach.at/diaspora-en.html — Hungarian identity in the diaspora, family memory, and 1956 (EN)
- https://1956.vipach.at/diaspora-de.html — Ungarische Identität in der Diaspora, Familienerinnerung und 1956 (DE)
- https://1956.vipach.at/gdpr-ai-trust.html

Sitemap:
- https://1956.vipach.at/sitemap.xml

Scope note:
- DÖR / Diaszpóra Összekötő Rendszer is outside this project and must not be inferred as part of it.
